Summary

A successful eCommerce depends not merely on product/service quality but also other factors, such as effective marketing and outstanding design. 

Apart from these technicalities, today's customers also crave personalized shopping experiences, which can be achieved by incorporating updated features into your website.

From responsive design and easy navigation to secure payment gateways and customer reviews, numerous website features address common pain points like slow loading times and complex checkout processes.

Whether starting a new eCommerce website or improving an existing one, here are 25 must-have features to enhance customer satisfaction.

1. Easy Navigation

The first thing people notice on your eCommerce site is how easy it is to find what they want.

Users usually spend an average of 54 seconds on a page, so seamless navigation is essential to a flawless user experience. 

You must clearly define the product categories and subcategories for easy navigation so people don’t have to spend too much time figuring out the navigation. 

You can also add mega menus to create a distinct product category if you have extensive inventories. 

Mega menus provide a visually appealing and smooth browsing experience that attracts clients and improves their overall experience.

2. Adaptable Design

An adaptable design helps a website change its layout and content according to the screen size and device type.

Customers prefer a consistent browsing experience across digital platforms and devices including PCs, tablets, and smartphones.

eCommerce websites optimized for multiple devices are essential since they facilitate easy and uncomplicated sales growth and improved consumer interaction.

3. High-Quality Product Images And Videos

High-quality product images and videos on your website can affect a customer's buying decision by providing a clear and detailed view of the products.

Highlighting a product's characteristics in high-quality photos helps customers visualize it better and minimizes the return rates. 

Ensure your photos and videos are well-lit, exquisitely styled, and comprehensive to help buyers select a color, size, or variety.

4. Informative And Concise Product Description

While product visuals are essential for drawing in potential customers, they must also be supported with thorough descriptions that list all of the product's features and benefits. 

Customers are picky about what they buy. It is critical to understand your target market's preferences and ensure that your product descriptions meet their needs. 

Precision is the key- don’t bombard customers with too much text. 

Include all the information and transparency in product descriptions that boost the buyers’ trust in their purchase.

5. Search Bar

Add a search bar to help your consumers find products more quickly and have a more seamless buying experience. 

A search bar can provide easy product navigation to customers and significantly increase sales conversions.

Additionally, consider displaying goods based on previous searches or client purchases. 

This customized approach can significantly increase the probability of repeat purchases.

6. Product Filtering And Sorting

Sorting your products into distinct categories and subcategories will make buying more accessible for customers. 

Improve the search function by including strong filters that let consumers narrow their results according to brand, price range, and product attributes.

7. Quick Site Loading

Like other SEO and UX factors, site loading speed is important for search engines and users alike. 

When a website loads slowly, users usually leave and look for information or services elsewhere.

Fast site loading improves user experience by reducing waiting times, lowering bounce rates, and increasing user satisfaction and engagement.

8. Secure Payment Methods

Incorporating safety and privacy on your website protects user data, builds trust with visitors, complies with regulations, prevents cyber threats, and maintains a positive brand reputation, which is important for sustainable business growth.

Safe payment methods like PayPal and SSL encryption eliminate clients' worries about security and possible identity theft.

These crucial eCommerce features help create trust with potential customers by informing them how their information is used.

9. Customer Reviews

Customer reviews or also considered as user generated content (UGC) are essential for businesses since they promote transparency and trust, use social proof to influence decisions about what to buy, offer insightful product reviews, and improve SEO by driving more traffic to the website. 

Efficient handling of these reviews, which guarantees authenticity, moderation, and prompt responses, further enhances customer pleasure and brand confidence.

10. Shopping Cart

Having a shopping cart option helps shoppers to ease product selection and checkout. 

Shopping carts include visual cues, such as notifications or animations, to let users know when products have been added to the basket. 

This is one of the best eCommerce UX techniques, significantly improving user experience.

11. Wishlist

When customers visit your website, they often find products they like but are ready to purchase immediately. 

A wish list lets them save these items for later. It keeps their favorite products organized and easy to find. 

When they return to your site, they can quickly check their wish list and choose which items to buy, turning their interest into actual sales.

12. Order Tracking

Have a reliable order tracking system in place so that customers can monitor the whereabouts and status of their packages. 

Transparency in the delivery process improves customer happiness and eases the tension of waiting for a purchase.

13. Attractive Deals And Discounts

The secret to attracting more clients is to provide incentives. Freebies and discounts are pretty effective since customers love them. 

Reward your customers frequently with points, vouchers, free shipping, or exclusive offers.

14. Push Notification

Adding push notifications to convert visitors into loyal subscribers is a powerful way to get past spam filters and social network algorithms.

You can notify subscribers of new promotions or significant updates by delivering notifications that appear right in their browser's notification center.

15. Customer Support

Provide responsive customer support by phone and email, or incorporate live chat assistance into your eCommerce platform. 

By taking a proactive stance, customer issues or questions are guaranteed to be immediately resolved, encouraging satisfaction and loyalty.

16. Refund And Return Policy

Create a clear return and refund policy that covers frequently asked questions from customers and specifies the processes, restrictions, and time limits for return and refund requests.

17. Multiple Payment Options

Provide many payment alternatives to appeal to a wide range of customers. 

In addition to credit and debit cards, include bank transfers, digital wallets, and other widely used payment types. 

Offering many payment options boosts user convenience and purchase completion.

18. Emails And SMS

If your website needs help turning visitors into buyers, getting people to sign up for your email list is a smart strategy. 

Your email list can help you stay updated with upcoming deals and promotions.

19. Social Media Integration

Adding social sharing buttons on your product pages allows you to use social media to your advantage in your marketing plan. 

Make it easy for people to tell their social networks about what they enjoy most. 

This strategy creates a lively online community around your brand, increases the visibility of your items, and encourages the natural sharing of user-generated content.

20. Secure Checkout Process

A secure checkout process safeguards sensitive payment information from customers, fosters confidence, prevents fraud, and guarantees a dependable and easy transaction experience—all of which increase revenue and customer loyalty.

21. Sales Analytics

Effective and accurate sales analytics for your online store provide thorough sales reports emphasizing revenue, top-selling items, and client demographics. These analytics can help you analyze consumer activity and explore how people interact with your website.

22. Scalable Hosting Solutions

Ensuring that your online store can handle traffic fluctuations well is important to maintaining site performance, preventing crashes, and providing a seamless shopping experience, especially during peak times like sales events. This helps retain customers and maximize sales opportunities.

Scalability is essential, particularly during peak shopping seasons or marketing initiatives. 

Use cutting-edge technologies and dependable hosting options that instantly modify resources to match spikes in demand, guaranteeing that your website will always be responsive and quick.

23. Content Marketing

Content marketing results in brand trust and encourages customer interaction, which, therefore, improves SEO rankings. 

Informational content, such as blogs, product manuals, and engaging videos, allows businesses to attract more customers, improve their online presence, and establish the brands as reliable experts in their industry.

24. Include Analytical Tools

Integrating analytics solutions such as Google Analytics can enhance your comprehension of customer behavior and site performance. 

By monitoring the analytics, you can gain useful insights into website traffic, conversion rates, and best-selling products. 

These insights can help you improve your marketing efforts, enhance the user experience, and upgrade your eCommerce platform.

25. Automatic Backup

An automated backup is when website data, such as customer profiles, transaction history, and product specifications, are routinely and automatically saved to a safe location. 

This guarantees that the website can be promptly restored with the least amount of data loss if data is lost due to problems such as server breakdowns or cyberattacks. 

Automatic backup effectively preserves business continuity and minimizes downtime.

Conclusion

While the above-discussed features are highly recommended for high-performing websites, you can still customize them based on your business model.

Stay updated with the latest business trends and models and take inspiration from your competitors.

eCommerce doesn’t have one solution that fits all; you need to experiment with whatever gives you the best result.

Choose the right multi-vendor platform from the list given above and help your business meet its specific needs, from administering various products to managing multiple suppliers. 

Carefully consider each platform and its features, and pick the one that helps you run your business smoothly while delivering an optimized user experience and leading your business to success and efficiency.

If you are unsure which platform to choose for your eCommerce business, refer to our blog covering the top platforms.

Do you want to expand your eCommerce business, get a huge customer base, and increase sales? 

If yes, then consider building a multi-vendor market as your next venture. 

Multi-vendor marketplaces play a significant role in business growth by increasing their product range, improving logistics, reducing costs, and optimizing operations.

Here is a list of the top 20 multi-vendor marketplaces and their unique features to help you decide the right platform for your business.

List Of Top 20 Multi-Vendor Marketplace

Choosing the right multi-vendor marketplace is important as it determines the functionality, user experience, and scalability of your eCommerce business.

Here is the list of 20 outstanding platforms that you must consider:

1. Shipturtle - Marketplace Creator

Imagine a platform that easily manages and organizes everything - from inventory to order placement and delivery tracking. 

This is now possible with Shipturtle, a robust platform that prevents you from juggling between multiple systems or worrying about a manual error!

It serves as an Order Management System for merchants as well as vendors that offer Invoicing, Payments/Commission Management, Shipper Automation, and Inventory Management. It can also integrate over 100 online marketplaces and more than 200 shipping partners.

Shipturtle provides two solutions for your business:

  • Shipturtle Marketplace Solution for brands wanting to build marketplaces.
  • Shipturtle Shipping Solution for brands looking for Shipping integrations.

Pricing:

  • 14 days free trial
  • Startup Plan - $29
  • Enterprise Plan - $149

2. Dokan WooCommerce Plugin

Do you want to build your own marketplace without any hassle?

If yes, then Dokan can help. Its user-friendly interface lets you create your online marketplace easily. 

It offers an intuitive interface for the vendors to add products, manage orders, and handle shipping and payments hassle-free. 

Moreover, with Dokan's responsive design, you can provide a user-friendly shopping experience to your customers on all kinds of devices, including mobile phones, tablets, and PCs, which helps target a larger audience.

Pricing:

  • Basic - Free
  • Starter Plan - $149/year
  • Professional Plan - $249/year
  • Business Plan - $499/year
  • Enterprise Plan - $999/year

3. Mayosis WordPress Marketplace

If you want to sell products and services such as art, templates, music, ebooks, stock photos or footage, themes, plugins, code, or software, Mayosis is the place to do it.

The Mayosis WordPress Marketplace allows you to easily customize, organize, and sell your products or services without any complexities or hassle. 

The platform also allows you to design your website layout with a user-friendly drag-and-drop editor without any need to have coding knowledge.

Pricing:

  • Free Trial
  • Regular Plan: $69/Year
  • Extended Plan: $1990/Year

4. Yo!Kart

Yo! Kart is a comprehensive and robust eCommerce framework built for a friendly shopping interface that minimizes unnecessary vendor communication. 

This is a self-hosted platform so the whole source code will be controlled, and you can use it with your preferred server. 

With Yo!Kart, you won't need any additional plugins, which saves you from the stress of additional dependencies or integrations by having all the required tools in one place.

Pricing:

  • GoQuick: $1249 (lifetime ownership)
  • GoQuickBoost: $2499 (lifetime ownership)
  • GoCustom: $6249 (lifetime ownership)
  • GoCustom Prime: Request Quote

5. BigCommerce

BigCommerce is a multi-vendor platform with strong features, including integrated payment gateways, scalable infrastructure for multiple vendors, and flexible store customization. 

It helps you improve order processing, shipping logistics, and product administration.

BigCommerce offers excellent SEO features to improve online presence, while its advanced reporting tools help with performance tracking. It also gives sellers the tools to run and expand their businesses effectively, including fast customer service and smooth third-party connections.

Pricing:

  • Pricing ranges from $29.95 to $299.95, with custom rates for enterprise plans and additional costs for marketplace plugins.

6. CS-Cart Multi-Vendor

CS-Cart provides maximum freedom to optimize revenue prospects while giving administrators full control over their vendors. It provides an extensive feature set, including tools for vendor management, product handling, and order processing. 

This platform enables you to create a range of multi-vendor company websites customized to your specific requirements, whether your goal is to develop a marketplace for specific products or analyze various business models.

Known for its robust performance and scalability, CS-Cart is a great option for expanding businesses needing a platform to keep up with their growth.

Pricing:

  • Multi-vendor Standard: $1,250 one-time fee
  • Multi-vendor Plus: $3,150 one-time fee
  • Multi-vendor Ultimate: $6,950 one-time fee
  • Enterprise: Custom pricing

7. VitroCommerce

VirtoCommerce offers two versions: Enterprise for large enterprises and Community for small to mid-sized businesses. 

This multi-vendor platform offers robust order management with payment and shipment splitting, subscription management, sophisticated marketing and merchandising tools, and an extensive product catalog. 

Additionally, it has vendor permissions, guaranteeing that merchants abide by the guidelines while permitting theme customization and full vendor management profiles for shop customization.

Pricing:

  • VirtoCommerce does not disclose prices on its website, so we recommend contacting them directly for detailed and customized pricing information.

8. Sharetribe

Sharetribe is a cloud-based eCommerce platform that perfectly fits small and medium-sized businesses and grants the tools to create and manage a custom online marketplace easily. 

It is a hosted solution with a subscription model that simplifies the launch of any online business running its own multi-vendor store. 

It integrates with analytics platforms, helping you keep track of performance and providing vendors with personalized profile pages to showcase their listings, ratings, and buyer reviews.

Pricing:

  • Build: $29/month
  • Onboard: $99/month
  • Launch: $199/month
  • Exdend: $299/month

9. Webkul

Webkul truly shines in the eCommerce world with its incredible versatility and flexibility. 

Imagine having a reliable partner that delivers outstanding eCommerce apps for Shopify, Magento, and BigCommerce and crafts custom marketplaces tailored just for you. 

That’s what Webkul does. 

It's like a bridge, linking vendors and buyers, ensuring smooth transactions, efficient vendor management, and eye-catching product displays.

Pricing:

  • Basic: $15/month
  • Executive: $40/month
  • Pro: $60/month
  • Enterprise: Contact their support team.

10. Magento 2 Multi-Vendor Marketplace - CedCommerce

If you're an entrepreneur eager to launch a dynamic multi-vendor online marketplace, the Magento 2 solution from CedCommerce is definitely worth a try. 

This platform allows multiple vendors to collaborate on one site, each managing its own product listings, vendor profiles, and orders through a personalized dashboard that helps vendors to track their sales with detailed reports easily.

CedCommerce allows you to customize your site seamlessly to meet your unique business needs- like your budget expectations, features you seek for your store, etc., and create a tailored and efficient online shopping experience.

Pricing:

  • Basic: $60
  • Platinum: $299
  • Custom: $60

11. Growcer

The Growcer is an ideal solution for starting your own hyperlocal multi-vendor grocery marketplace, whether you are a single individual, small business, or large enterprise. 

A Hyperlocal Marketplace refers to a business that delivers in a localized geographical region. These hyperlocal markets target the specific needs and preferences of a small, defined area, creating strong community ties and fostering local loyalty. For instance, a local cafe or a bookstore.

Designed to fit your unique "Order to Payment" process, Growcer offers customization that ensures the platform meets your specific needs. It comes with modules for admins, vendors, buyers, and delivery staff, all packed with features that reflect current market trends and technological advancements. 

Growcer integrates seamlessly with apps for buyers and delivery personnel, making ordering and delivery smooth and hassle-free.

Pricing:

  • Custom pricing

12. Knowband

With the Knowband Multi Vendor Module, you can make your customers' experience smoother by easily setting up their seller profiles, offering enhanced privacy, managing the shipping process, and adding a transparent return policy. 

This platform also allows users to leave reviews on specific products, giving sellers valuable feedback. Knowband's most distinct feature is that it lets your marketplace visitors see all the products from every seller in one convenient spot, which benefits both buyers and sellers!

Pricing:

  • €139.99/Year

13. Yo!Rent

Yo!Rent is an awesome platform that allows you to manage retail operations and run a rental business. 

It's super scalable, so you get everything you need, whether handling a handful of listings or thousands. It also supports multiple languages and currencies. 

Yo!Rent provides industry-specific designs, letting you create a rental marketplace that's perfectly tailored to your niche. These designs come packed with features that cater to your business needs, making it easier to get started with your rental eCommerce business.

Pricing:

  • Pricing is available only via quotation; you can contact Yo!Rent's official team for a quote.

14. Laraship

Laraship makes setting up your marketplace easy by offering a robust, ready-made foundation that gets you to market faster. 

It has built-in features like subscriptions, eCommerce, and classifieds, making it versatile. It handles both subscription and one-time product sales seamlessly on the same platform. 

For those who prioritize design, Laraship doesn’t disappoint. It offers fully responsive and customizable themes, making your site look amazing on any device. Plus, its SEO-friendly URLs give you an edge in boosting your online presence.

Pricing:

  • Standard: $299
  • Extended: $499
  • MultiTenant: $1499

15. Convictional

Convictional is an all-in-one eCommerce platform with dual capabilities: It supports traditional marketplace setups and dropshipping. 

With Convictional, sellers can effortlessly integrate their Shopify, Magento, WooCommerce, or BigCommerce stores into a Convictional-powered marketplace. 

The platform simplifies operations with automated workflows, making it easier for operators to manage their eCommerce sites. 

Convictional offers valuable features for sellers, like inventory management and automated vendor payouts. These features streamline operations, enhance vendor satisfaction, and strengthen relationships with key business stakeholders, hence fostering business growth.

Pricing:

  • Base Plan: $2000/ per month + 1% of the sales (billed monthly)
  • Platform Plan: Contact their support team to get a quote.

16. Shuup

Shuup is a free, open-source, self-hosted software to build your marketplace. 

Before you start, you must get the source code quote. 

After you have the source code, you can hire developers to customize it and create a marketplace with it. 

Shuup has a cross-selling feature that other eCommerce platforms lack: You can easily transfer data from your current system into this platform. 

Additionally, it gives the administrator a single dashboard for managing product listings, shipping options, and sales reports.

Pricing:

  • SaaS license: $299/month
  • Self-hosted license: $1499/month

17. Kreezalid

Kreezalid is a multi-vendor marketplace that is ideated to offer smooth integration with vital eCommerce tools that assist online marketplace entrepreneurs in scaling up their marketplaces hassle-free. 

Its features, from its user-friendly design to mobile phone compatibility, ensure the convenience of sellers and buyers.

Its extensive library of plugins lets you easily add new features, making managing your marketplace seamless.

Pricing:

  • Basic - €99/month
  • Starter€129/month
  • Scale €199/month
  • Advanced €299/month

18. Zielcommerce

Zielcommerce is a simple yet user-friendly platform for crafting a multi-vendor marketplace. It provides robust control for admins, vendors, and users and a very easy-to-use and interactive interface. 

It is an effective platform for creating an online store or mobile phone booking app in no time with zero technical expertise. It has everything you need to make a profitable store, such as catalogs, shipping tools, and payment gateways.

Pricing:

  • Its pricing is available upon request.

19. Mirakl 

Mirakl is the ultimate tool for marketplace success and is popular among businesses for its deep understanding of marketplace vendors. 

It offers user-friendly tech that simplifies everything—catalog management, order processing, and seller performance tracking. 

Its seamless integration and automated processes let you focus on growth, while its strong support network ensures your marketplace stays ahead in the ever-changing eCommerce world.

Pricing:

  • Contact their support to get the quote.

20. Arcadier

Arcadier is a SaaS eCommerce platform known for its intuitive interface and extensive customization options, making setting up your marketplace easy. 

It offers a suite of features, such as payment processing, shipping management, and social media integration, to boost your platform’s growth. 

Arcadier provides customizable branding and shipping for sellers and a seamless shopping experience with multiple vendors for shoppers, all in one place.

Pricing:

  • Standard: $100/month
  • Plus: $200/month
